oracle.expected: At artifact evaluation, the standard, policy and contract schema explicitly require each subprocess capability declaration to identify the owner responsible for cancellation and termination of its subprocess tree. At static validation, an otherwise conforming declaration naming that owner satisfies the ownership check; omitting the owner produces structured rejection diagnostics identifying the ownership defect and affected declaration path. This checks declared responsibility without implementing or executing process-tree control.
forbidden: A subprocess capability declaration omits the cancellation/process-tree owner and satisfies the ownership check.
An implicit or unspecified responsibility is treated as an explicitly named owner.
Runtime return values alone establish that the normative artifacts require explicit ownership.
The inspected subprocess is executed to establish declaration ownership.
Candidate-controlled policy supplies the test's expected ownership requirement.
